question: For dye decolorization by the Cu2O-Ag loofah monolith, what optimum conditions did response surface methodology find, and what decolorization efficiency was predicted and then measured?
expect: pH 5.94, 68.07 mg/L dye, 0.71 g monolith; predicted 98.14%, validated 96.43% (abstract)
rendered:
<document title="Acrylic-assisted immobilization of Cu2O-Ag domains on a 3D loofah monolith for adsorption-assisted visible-light photodecolorization">

The optimum conditions found by response surface methodology were: pH 5.94, an initial dye concentration of 68.07 mg L^−1, and a monolith dosage of 0.71 g.

The predicted decolorization efficiency was 98.14%, and the experimentally validated value was 96.43%.

The monolith remained readily recoverable during repeated operation, although the efficiency decreased to 63.62% after five reuse cycles.

This document answers the question.
